The magic of Zanzibar lies in its ability to surprise you at every turn. This guide is for anyone seeking luxury in Zanzibar who wants to experience the real heart of this incredible destination. From sunrise viewpoints to late-night street food stalls, Zanzibar rewards the curious traveler. We have gathered the best tips, must-visit spots, and practical advice to help you explore with confidence and leave with stories worth telling.

## Luxury Accommodation

- Five-star resorts with private beaches and butler service where every need is anticipated before you ask
- Boutique hotels housed in historic buildings with modern amenities and impeccable design
- Private villas with infinity pools and panoramic views that make waking up a pleasure
- Exclusive retreats offering personalized spa treatments and wellness programs tailored to you
